exposure: Cause of PPH (uterine atony vs. placenta praevia)
Blood loss > 1.5 l at the start of the procedure
cohort: 96 patients who underwent IUBT (n=67) or compression sutures (n=29) for major PPH (>1000 ml)
finding: Both IUBT and compression sutures had similar overall success rates in controlling severe PPH, but IUBT showed better success in cases of placenta praevia.
mod_finding: While there were no other dominating patient characteristics favoring either procedure, vaginal deliveries were more common in the IUBT group compared to the compression sutures group.
